notes: Fastest spring of the set (k632). Two independent carousels stacked on one screen — they need directionalLock or they fight for the gesture.

description.one_line_summary: A multi-carousel pricing screen featuring independent horizontal swiping for feature showcases and subscription plans.
description.detailed_description: Two independent horizontal carousels present information. The top carousel showcases premium features with animated mockups. The bottom carousel displays payment plans with dedicated CTAs. Swiping either section triggers a smooth, springy horizontal slide that snaps cleanly into place.

motion_breakdown.start_state: A feature card is centred in the top half of the screen, and a pricing plan card in the bottom half.
motion_breakdown.transition: Swiping horizontally on either card slides the active card out of view while the adjacent card slides in, snapping into place with a subtle spring bounce.
motion_breakdown.end_state: The newly selected card is centred and fully active, updating the displayed content or pricing option.
motion_breakdown.why_it_works: Decoupling the feature showcase from the pricing plans lets users digest the value proposition and the cost options independently, while the tactile snapping makes exploration feel responsive.
